svg.title: AgriSys — full multi-agent multi-model expert system architecture
svg.desc: Six-layer architecture for a multi-crop India-focused agricultural expert system: input layer with five modalities, preprocessing, orchestrator, five specialist agents, shared RAG and knowledge base, and explainable web output layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the text query input module and multilingual NLP preprocessing')
sendPrompt('Explain the voice input ASR pipeline and Whisper fine-tuning for Indian languages')
sendPrompt('Explain the image input pipeline — formats, resizing, and preprocessing for disease diagnosis')
sendPrompt('Explain the sensor and IoT input module — soil NPK, pH, humidity, weather station integration')
sendPrompt('Explain the live price data input — Agmarknet, eNAM, and MSP feed integration')
sendPrompt('How does the ASR and Bhashini TTS pipeline work end to end?')
sendPrompt('Explain image quality check, EXIF cleaning, and augmentation before model inference')
sendPrompt('How are sensor readings validated, calibrated, and normalised before use?')
sendPrompt('How is live mandi price data cleaned, cached, and served in real time?')
sendPrompt('Explain the orchestrator in depth — intent classification, agent routing logic, multi-turn memory, and fallback strategy')
g.text: GPT-4o / Gemini 1.5 Pro backbone · routes queries to 5 domains
Multi-turn Redis memory · parallel dispatch · confidence gating

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Go deep on the disease diagnostic agent — ViT architecture, LoRA fine-tuning, datasets, LLMI-CDP pipeline, and AgriChain chain-of-thought reasoning')
sendPrompt('Go deep on the nutrition and deficiency agent — cross-modal fusion of leaf image and soil sensor data, CNN architecture, N-P-K recommendation model')
sendPrompt('Go deep on the crop recommendation agent — XGBoost model, SHAP explainability, soil-climate-yield feature set, and multi-crop India dataset')
sendPrompt('Go deep on the weather and irrigation advisory agent — LSTM forecast model, IMD API integration, pest outbreak early warning trigger')
sendPrompt('Go deep on the market price and advisory agent — Agmarknet scraping, price trend ML, MSP comparison, and sell/hold recommendation')
sendPrompt('Explain the advanced RAG pipeline in full — semantic chunking strategy, bi-encoder embedding model, Qdrant vector store, cross-encoder reranking, HyDE query expansion, and MMR diversity')
sendPrompt('What are all the knowledge sources ingested — ICAR PoP, KCC call logs, CGIAR, FAO, Agmarknet, IMD, PlantVillage?')
sendPrompt('How does the hallucination guard work — LLM-as-judge, self-consistency sampling, confidence threshold, and expert escalation trigger?')

g.text: Explainable web output — React PWA · FastAPI backend · WebSocket · Bhashini TTS · Grad-CAM · SHAP
